title: Megan Thee Stallion Enters Fragrance Industry With Hot Girl Summer Perfume ‘That Captures My Essence’
summary: Early access purchases will be available starting in July.
contentText:
Every Hot Girl will have a new scent this summer. Megan Thee Stallion has entered the fragrance space with the launch of the Hot Girl Summer Eau de Parfum on Wednesday (July 1).

Megan adds to her business portfolio with the perfume launch, which will give fans a chance to smell just like the Grammy-winning rapper. The Hot Girl Summer fragrance will be sold in 90 ml and 10 ml bottle sizes starting on July 5 for early access customers.

“Perfume is the last thing you put on, but it’s the first thing people remember,” Megan said in a statement. “If you’ve ever hugged me, chances are you’ve asked what I was wearing, and now I can finally say it’s my own fragrance.”

She continued: “Launching Hot Girl Summer Eau de Parfum really gave me the opportunity to develop a scent that captures my essence and also brings one of my favorite beauty essentials to life in a way that’s true to me.”

The fragrance is set to be available exclusively through Ulta Beauty and Megan Thee Stallion’s website. Hot Girl Summer Eau de Parfum will also be available online starting on July 8, and then in Ulta stores on July 11.

Drawing from Megan’s fiery persona, the perfume comes in the alluring shape of a burning flame. And according to the press release, the Hot Girl Summer fragrance blends a mix of “creamy coconut milk, orchid blooms and warm vetiver oil” for a “radiant and sensual” scent.

Courtesy Photo

On the music side, the Houston rapper shared she is working on  securing a “big budget”  for her anticipated upcoming  Act III  album.

The Houston Hottie’s last project,  Megan , was released in 2024 and debuted at No. 3 on the  Billboard 200.
